findings.claim: JobRunr 7.3.2 @Recurring exposes an interval() member (org.jobrunr.jobs.annotations.Recurring.interval()), so @Recurring(interval="PT30S") sub-minute sweep is valid — asserted as 'підтверджено/confirmed'
findings.evidence: UNVERIFIED library-API claim with NO in-repo precedent. Confirmed this session: ALL three existing @Recurring usages use cron = "0 3 * * *" — ExportCleanupJob.java:56, HardDeleteJob.java:33, ProjectHardDeleteJob.java:59 — and NONE use interval=. So there is zero in-repo evidence that @Recurring(interval=...) compiles/works on 7.3.2; jobrunr-spring-boot-3-starter:7.3.2 is confirmed (build.gradle:31) but the Recurring.interval() member itself was not inspectable (decompiling the jar is outside the codebase-grep scope). code-research.md §4 lines 200-203 explicitly lists this as an OPEN QUESTION. at-most-once correctness does NOT depend on cadence (atomic claim covers it), but the chosen cadence mechanism rests on an unconfirmed library API, and user-spec required tech-spec to confirm 7.3.2 support and keep a cron-1min fallback. FIX: inspect org.jobrunr.jobs.annotations.Recurring in the 7.3.2 jar (or JobRunr 7.3.x docs) to confirm interval() exists; if not, fall back to cron 1-min as user-spec authorized. The tech-spec's repeated 'підтверджено/confirmed' wording overstates the available evidence.

findings.claim: poll-interval is already 15s via org.jobrunr.background-job-server.poll-interval-in-seconds=15 in application.properties (Decision 2 cites this exact property as justification that 30s interval >= poll)
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED MIRAGE. Read full application.properties this session: the ONLY JobRunr properties are line 36 org.jobrunr.background-job-server.enabled=true and line 37 org.jobrunr.dashboard.enabled=false. There is NO org.jobrunr.background-job-server.poll-interval-in-seconds property in the file at all. 15s is JobRunr's built-in DEFAULT poll-interval; the tech-spec misstates the default as an explicit configured property. The interval>=poll reasoning still holds against the default, but the assertion that the property is set to 15 in application.properties is false. FIX: reword to 'JobRunr default poll-interval (15s)' or actually add the property if explicitness is desired.
